title: Discovering Jailbreaks via Curriculum of Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.38833v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated jailbreak discovery aims to find prompts that elicit prohibited behaviors from safety-trained language models, helping developers identify vulnerabilities before deployment. One class of approaches uses reinforcement learning to train an investigator model to generate prompts that elicit a specified behavior from a target model. However, training directly against a safety-trained target is difficult because nearly all prompts are refused, leaving the investigator with a sparse reward signal. Prior work addresses this with the propensity bound (PRBO), a proxy reward estimated by sampling responses from a more compliant target, and then adjusting for how likely those responses would have been under the original target. translated_title: 通过模型课程发现越狱攻击
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.38833v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：自动化越狱发现旨在找到能够诱导经过安全训练的语言模型产生禁止行为的提示词，帮助开发者在模型部署之前识别漏洞。其中一类方法使用强化学习训练一个“调查者”模型，使其生成能够从目标模型中诱导出指定行为的提示词。然而，直接针对经过安全训练的目标模型进行训练十分困难，因为几乎所有提示词都会被拒绝，使得调查者模型只能获得稀疏的奖励信号。先前的工作通过倾向界限来解决这一问题：该代理奖励通过从一个更加顺从的目标模型中采样响应来估计，再根据这些响应在原始目标模型下出现的可能性进行校正。我们提出了模型课程，这是一种替代方法，它让调查者模型针对目标模型的一系列修改版本进行训练，从一个容易表现出该行为的版本逐步过渡到……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“模型课程”方法，通过让强化学习调查者模型针对一系列由易到难的目标模型修改版本循序渐进地训练，克服了直接攻击安全训练模型时奖励信号过于稀疏的难题，从而更有效地自动发现越狱提示词。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Curriculum of Models (CoM), which trains an RL-based investigator model against a sequence of progressively harder modified versions of the target, overcoming the sparse-reward problem of directly attacking safety-trained LLMs to discover jailbreak prompts more effectively.
